summary_en: The Intelligent Mobile Cabin Hospital is designed with lightweight and modular concepts, integrating professional medical hardware with smart information systems. It possesses sea-land-air amphibious mobility for global deployment. The system can be rapidly expanded within 36 hours and retrieved within 24 hours, significantly boosting response efficiency. It handles mass casualty treatment, epidemic control, disaster relief, and international aid, providing all-weather, standardized medical support for complex disaster sites.

key_application_en: Sea-land-air global mobility with 36-hour rapid deployment; all-weather and all-terrain medical support for mass casualty rescue, epidemic prevention, and humanitarian aid.
